```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(leaflet)
library(sf)

tracts <- st_read("sarasota_tracts_under18_2024.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326) # Leaflet expects WGS84 longitude/latitude coordinates

# Map percent_under_18 values to the reversed magma color palette
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "magma",
  domain = tracts$percent_under_18,
  reverse = TRUE
)

leaflet(tracts) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(percent_under_18),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    label = ~paste0(NAME, ": ", round(percent_under_18, 1), "% under 18"),
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#18324b",
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~percent_under_18,
    labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%"),
    title = "Residents under 18",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```

Each shape on this map of Sarasota County, Florida represents a census tract. Darker colors indicate a larger share of residents under age 18, based on the 2024 American Community Survey 5-year estimates from the U.S. Census Bureau. Hover over any tract to see its exact percentage of children.
